suggestions.title: Add a standings reconciliation gate that blocks a publish when a club's record disagrees with the official page
suggestions.why: The site currently serves NYG 5-2-1 and WAS 2-5-1 while the official page reads 5-3-1 and 3-5-1, because the Thursday game went final after the snapshot was taken.
suggestions.how: Fetch the official standings page in the same run, parse 32 rows, compare W-L-T to the snapshot, fail on any difference unless the fetch itself failed (then mark the run official_unreachable and publish with a banner).
suggestions.cost: Low - one script, one workflow step
suggestions.risk: A fetch failure must not silently pass

suggestions.title: Make the observed-price leaderboard the only headline table
suggestions.why: Two boards are live. The one readers see assumes -110 on every bet; the priced one excludes unpriced games but measures a return that exists.
suggestions.how: Render data/s9cb/leaderboard.json as the headline; move the -110 board to a labelled sensitivity page with the assumption in the first column.
suggestions.risk: Some rules drop below the 200-bet minimum and must be shown as unscored

suggestions.title: Add a unit test that pins the leaderboard sort order to its caption
suggestions.why: The ordering is currently correct (sorted by the lower 95% ROI bound), but nothing enforces it; a renderer change would silently break the sentence beside the table.
suggestions.how: Assert that the rendered row order equals the score_lower_ci_roi_pct order, and that the caption string is present.

suggestions.title: Publish the sample filter and n beside every correlation
suggestions.why: C1 reproduces as r=0.4309 on 7,103 games but the site publishes 0.4312 on 6,975 games. The value is reproducible; the sample is not.
suggestions.how: Add filter, n, excluded count and source file to each row; fail the build if any is missing.

suggestions.title: Render the 31-club depth-chart scrape that already exists
suggestions.why: 934 sourced position rows covering 31 clubs are committed, but the published page shows 3 clubs.
suggestions.how: Render data/session-1505ac8e/depth_charts.json with a per-club anchor and a coverage counter; render HOU as 'no chart captured'.
suggestions.risk: Chart dates are not comparable across clubs (Q-08)

suggestions.title: Carry a three-state availability column instead of one blended index
suggestions.why: 9 of 296 injury rows carry a game designation. Folding 'no designation yet' into the same number as 'fit' makes an unreported club look healthy.
suggestions.how: Add game_status_state in {out, doubtful, questionable, practice-only, cleared}. Show the practice-only weight as a model parameter, not a statistic.

suggestions.title: Declare an authoritative generation per table on the landing page
suggestions.why: Several generations publish overlapping numbers. A reader cannot tell which one to trust for standings.
suggestions.how: One table on the front door: table, authoritative page, last verified, other copies.
suggestions.risk: Readers may still prefer an older page

suggestions.title: Promote the official-source audit to a required check
suggestions.why: The audit exists and runs, but a hard mismatch does not stop a merge.
suggestions.how: Add the job to required status checks; document the override path with a recorded reason.
suggestions.risk: A flaky upstream fetch blocks merges; mitigate with retry and an explicit override

suggestions.title: Keep props projection-only and state the block once, prominently
suggestions.why: No prop price exists in any source, so no prop bet can be scored; a prop leaderboard without prices would be invented.
suggestions.how: Keep the price column blank with a badge; add one sentence to the landing page explaining why the third bet type is unscoreable.

suggestions.title: Collect the official inactive lists once they are published
suggestions.why: Inactives are the only official record of who actually dressed; without them 'Questionable' never resolves.
suggestions.how: Per week, capture the official inactives article linked from the injury page; parse game, club, player, status; store with URL and fetch time.
suggestions.risk: URL pattern changes weekly; must fail loudly

suggestions.title: Link the market number to its feed on every row
suggestions.why: The own-lines table cites the nfl.com schedule page, which publishes no spread. The number is modelled from a pinned feed and the row does not say so.
suggestions.how: Split the source column into fixture (official) and market feed (provenance-pinned).

suggestions.title: Give index.html a single writer
suggestions.why: pipeline/gen_site.py and tools/build.py both write it; the second one wins, so CI verifies a page the site does not serve.
suggestions.how: tools/build.py writes legacy-site.html; tools/verify.py reads the new name; add a grep test that only one module writes index.html.

suggestions.title: Freeze the reward formula before any rule passes
suggestions.why: Reward values are unpublished by any official source and defining them after a winner appears is post-hoc selection.
suggestions.how: Version and date the formula; keep values blank until a human sets them.
suggestions.risk: The formula can still be changed later

suggestions.title: Publish the list of signals that were tested and failed, with their effect sizes
suggestions.why: Twelve rules are tested and none pass. The failures are the most valuable output of the lab and they are buried.
suggestions.how: A table: signal, sample, point estimate, interval, verdict. Never a single number without its interval.

suggestions.title: Add an out-of-sample decay column to every rule
suggestions.why: A rule can look good over 20 seasons and be dead in the last two; the holdout column exists but is not shown beside the headline.
suggestions.how: Show holdout ROI next to full-sample ROI in the same row.
